records.full_name: XML Localization Interchange File Format (v1.2 / v2.0 / v2.1)
records.purpose: OASIS standard XML container for lossless extraction and transport of localizable source text, target translations, inline tags, and segment states across CAT/TMS tools.
records.technical_details: Uses <trans-unit> (v1.2) or <unit>/<segment> (v2.x) with <source> and <target> elements, inline placeholder tags (<g>, <x/>, <ph>), and state attributes (new, translated, signed-off, final).

records.purpose: Vendor-neutral XML standard (originally OSCAR/LISA, now GALA) for exporting, migrating, and sharing Translation Memory (TM) databases between CAT/TMS platforms.
software: All CAT tools and TMS platforms
records.technical_details: Consists of <header> metadata and <body> containing <tu> (Translation Unit) records with <tuv xml:lang='...'> (Translation Unit Variant) and <seg> content.

records.purpose: ISO 30042 XML standard for concept-oriented terminology databases (termbases), storing approved, forbidden, and deprecated terms across multiple languages.
records.industry: Enterprise, Regulated Life Sciences, Automotive, Software, Legal
records.technical_details: Concept-oriented structure (<conceptEntry> / <termEntry>) grouping language sections (<langSec>) and term sections (<termSec>) with part-of-speech, definition, and usage status.

records.purpose: Key-value resource files powering web apps (react-i18next, next-intl, FormatJS) and Flutter mobile apps (.arb) with ICU MessageFormat plural/gender syntax.
records.technical_details: Monolingual per-locale JSON trees (e.g. en.json, ja.json); ARB adds @key metadata objects for descriptions and placeholder typing.

records.purpose: ZIP-packaged XML representation of Adobe InDesign (.indd) layouts enabling CAT tools to extract stories cleanly without corrupting binary .indd files.
records.industry: Marketing, Publishing, Packaging, Medical Device IFUs, Technical Manuals
records.technical_details: ZIP archive containing designmap.xml, Stories/Story_*.xml, Spreads/, Styles.xml, and Fonts.xml.

records.full_name: Timed Text Markup Language / IMSC1 Profile
records.purpose: W3C XML timed text standard mandated by Netflix, Disney+, and IMF broadcast workflows for frame-accurate subtitling, styling, ruby annotations (Japanese), and vertical positioning.
records.industry: OTT Streaming, Broadcast TV, Film Distribution
records.technical_details: Supports SMPTE timecodes, frame rate declarations (ttp:frameRate), region positioning, and CJK bouten/ruby markup.
